comments.author: @MRiitta
comments.text: First time I hear about this extraordinary cooling system and I'm already 77 yo.!! Thank you so much
comments.replyText: Thank you so much for watching! It is amazing that nature solved the cooling problem millions of years before we did. So glad you learned something new — that is exactly why we make these. Welcome to the channel!

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Releases 90% of body heat through spots alone
clipCandidates.why: Concrete number — 90% of body heat through spots. Never pants or sweats at 100 degrees. Strong payoff.
